dialogues.jp: 桜の匂い。
dialogues.en: The scent of cherry blossom.
dialogues.text: The scent of cherry blossom.

dialogues.jp: 風の音。
dialogues.en: The sound of wind.
dialogues.text: The sound of wind.

dialogues.jp: ｛こずえ／梢｝が打ち鳴らされるざわめき。
dialogues.en: The rustling noise on the top of the trees.
dialogues.text: The rustling noise on the top of the trees.

dialogues.jp: この夢……空気で分かる。
dialogues.en: I know this is a dream by the feeling of the air.
dialogues.text: I know this is a dream by the feeling of the air.

dialogues.jp: 目がうっすらと開く。
dialogues.en: I slightly open my eyes.
dialogues.text: I slightly open my eyes.

dialogues.en: (Where am I?)
dialogues.text: (Where am I?)

dialogues.jp: やはり音夢の夢か……。
dialogues.en: Oh, this is Nemu's dream as I thought.
dialogues.text: Oh, this is Nemu's dream as I thought.

dialogues.jp:
しかし初めてのことだが、完全に音夢の視点と
重なってしまっている。
dialogues.en:
This is the first time I've been in one of her dreams, but
there's a lot of overlap with mine.
dialogues.text:
This is the first time I've been in one of her dreams, but
there's a lot of overlap with mine.

dialogues.jp: すぐ近くにいて影響が強いのか。
dialogues.en: The influence is very strong because we live closely.
dialogues.text: The influence is very strong because we live closely.

dialogues.jp: 違う……。
dialogues.en: No...
dialogues.text: No...

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: （音夢がからっぽなんだ）
dialogues.en: (I think Nemu feels empty.)
dialogues.text: (I think Nemu feels empty.)

dialogues.jp:
明らかに音夢の身体なのに、その場にいるべき
音夢という存在が希薄なのだ。
dialogues.en:
I'm definitely in Nemu's body, but I don't feel her
existence in there.
dialogues.text:
I'm definitely in Nemu's body, but I don't feel her
existence in there.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ゆっくりとでも、桜の花びらが降り積もるよ
　うに――」
dialogues.en: "It's like the cherry petals falling down on the ground."
dialogues.text: "It's like the cherry petals falling down on the ground."

dialogues.jp: さく――ら？
dialogues.en: Sakura?
dialogues.text: Sakura?

dialogues.jp: うっすらとまぶたを持ち上げる。
dialogues.en: I open my eyes slowly.
dialogues.text: I open my eyes slowly.

dialogues.jp: 月と冷たい光が見下ろしている。
dialogues.en: I see the cold moonlight beaming down onto me.
dialogues.text: I see the cold moonlight beaming down onto me.

dialogues.jp:
普段の無邪気なさくらではなく、吹雪の中の｛ふ／不｝
｛とうこ／凍湖｝を思わせる深い青色が、音夢と俺を見下ろ
している。
dialogues.en:
This isn't the innocent Sakura I see every day. Her deep
blue eyes look down at Nemu and me like in a blizzard.
dialogues.text:
This isn't the innocent Sakura I see every day. Her deep
blue eyes look down at Nemu and me like in a blizzard.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「美しくても、地に落ちてしまえば汚れてしま
　う、花びらのように」
dialogues.en:
"They're like flower petals that get dirty once they fall
down on the ground."
dialogues.text:
"They're like flower petals that get dirty once they fall
down on the ground."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ひどく｛かんまん／緩慢｝だけれども、やがて心も｛きし／軋｝みだす」
dialogues.en:
"It's at a slower pace, but it's sure to kill your heart
eventually."
dialogues.text:
"It's at a slower pace, but it's sure to kill your heart
eventually."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「音夢ちゃん……やっぱり発症しかかっている
　んだね」
dialogues.en: "Nemu's about to get sick, isn't she?"
dialogues.text: "Nemu's about to get sick, isn't she?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「夢の中でまで意識が｛もうろう／朦朧｝としているなんて
　……なんでそこまでお兄ちゃんを想うの？」
dialogues.en:
"I can't believe you're groggy even in the dream. Why do you
like him so much?"
dialogues.text:
"I can't believe you're groggy even in the dream. Why do you
like him so much?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「自己を失ってまで、お兄ちゃんとの思い出を
　手放したくないの？」
dialogues.en:
"You don't want to lose all your memories with him by dying
yourself, do you?"
dialogues.text:
"You don't want to lose all your memories with him by dying
yourself, do you?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: （｛わたし／俺｝は――）
俺の言葉にのせて音夢の言葉が漏れる。
dialogues.en: I hear Nemu's voice along with mine.
dialogues.text: I hear Nemu's voice along with mine.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: （｛ここはあなたのゆめね／ここはどこだ｝さくら？）
dialogues.en: (Where am I? I'm in your dream, right, Sakura?)
dialogues.text: (Where am I? I'm in your dream, right, Sakura?)

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ちょっと違う。夢を見る力はあくまで副産物
　だから」
dialogues.en:
"That's not quite right. The ability to get here in a dream
is a total coincidence."
dialogues.text:
"That's not quite right. The ability to get here in a dream
is a total coincidence."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ここはみんなの夢の通り道……本当なら音夢
　ちゃんには来れない深いところ」
dialogues.en:
"This is the passage of everybody's dream. Usually, you
can't come inside this deep."
dialogues.text:
"This is the passage of everybody's dream. Usually, you
can't come inside this deep."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「お兄ちゃんとボクと、あの桜のために用意さ
　れた……」
dialogues.en: "This is only for oniichan, me, and the other Sakura."
dialogues.text: "This is only for oniichan, me, and the other Sakura."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「魔法使いの見る夢」
dialogues.en: "The dream that a witch can have."
dialogues.text: "The dream that a witch can have."

dialogues.jp:
さくらも音夢も、俺のことには気づいていない
のか？
dialogues.en: I wonder if Sakura and Nemu haven't noticed me.
dialogues.text: I wonder if Sakura and Nemu haven't noticed me.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「でも安心して……もうすぐこの夢も覚める」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry, you'll be out of this dream soon."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry, you'll be out of this dream soon."

dialogues.jp:
さくらは、小さく、力の無い微笑みを湛えて続
ける。
dialogues.en: Sakura smiles sadly.
dialogues.text: Sakura smiles sadly.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「人の心はとても強いもので……」
dialogues.en: "The human mind is stronger than you think."
dialogues.text: "The human mind is stronger than you think."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「――とても弱いものだから」
dialogues.en: "But the human body is very fragile."
dialogues.text: "But the human body is very fragile."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「これ以上は――」
dialogues.en: "This is it..."
dialogues.text: "This is it..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: （｛さくら／さくら｝）
dialogues.en: (Sakura----)
dialogues.text: (Sakura----)

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「――うにゃ、わわわ、お兄ちゃん！？」
dialogues.en: "Huh, waahh, oniichan!?"
dialogues.text: "Huh, waahh, oniichan!?"

dialogues.jp: 慌ててさくらの手が伸びてくる。
dialogues.en: Flustered, Sakura reaches out to me.
dialogues.text: Flustered, Sakura reaches out to me.

dialogues.jp: ドン――！
dialogues.en: Bang!
dialogues.text: Bang!

dialogues.jp: 突き飛ばされたような衝撃。
dialogues.en: An impact as if I was blown away.
dialogues.text: An impact as if I was blown away.

dialogues.jp: 底のない穴に突き飛ばされたように。
dialogues.en: It's as if I were pushed down a bottomless pit.
dialogues.text: It's as if I were pushed down a bottomless pit.

dialogues.jp: そのまま眠りに落ちた。
dialogues.en: I sink into sleep.
dialogues.text: I sink into sleep.

dialogues.jp: ◆さくらと音夢の夢◆
dialogues.en: ◆The dream of Sakura and Nemu◆
dialogues.text: ◆The dream of Sakura and Nemu◆

dialogues.jp:
音夢と同化したような夢の中で、普段とは異な
る不思議な雰囲気をまとったさくらと｛たいじ／対峙｝した。
dialogues.en:
While I was in Nemu's dream, Sakura confronted us, in a
sinister mood.
dialogues.text:
While I was in Nemu's dream, Sakura confronted us, in a
sinister mood.

dialogues.jp:
俺との思い出をなくしたくないために、身体を
弱らせている音夢。
dialogues.en:
Nemu weakened her health on purpose not to lose any memory
with me.
dialogues.text:
Nemu weakened her health on purpose not to lose any memory
with me.

dialogues.jp:
そんな事情を聞いていたら、さくらに俺の存在
がばれて、夢から追い出された。
dialogues.en:
When I was listening to her situation, Sakura found out who
I was and kicked me out of the dream.
dialogues.text:
When I was listening to her situation, Sakura found out who
I was and kicked me out of the dream.
